mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate decline >0.2% in 1 month does not produce positive 20d returns in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 2.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth) combined with tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals an overheating economy and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS > 2.0%
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS rising >0.5% and FEDFUNDS>2.0%) occurs in 10+ instances but SPX 5d returns are positive in >50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the regime defined by UNRATE<4.0% and INDPRO>105.0, RSAFS decline >0.3% in 1 month does not predict negative 20d returns (SPX 20d returns >0 in >50% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline >0.2% in 1 month does not produce positive 5d returns in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals weakening residential construction and broader economic demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls < 1300.0 in 1 month but SPX 20d returns are positive in >50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) combined with slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 qoq growth < 0.2%) signals a supply-driven economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 qoq growth < 0.2% AND INDPRO growth > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint condition (GDPC1 qoq growth <0.2% and INDPRO growth >0.5% in 1 month) occurs in 10+ instances but SPX 60d returns are positive in >50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), elevated inflation signals central bank tightening and reduced real equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, SPX 20d returns are positive in >50% of instances.
